desc:
⛏️  Pixels is an endless open-world survival adventure sandbox game!

**This is the NO PVP / NO COMBAT / NO DAMAGE version of the game. For the combat version, enter the game and click on the button to change servers on your inventory!

🏠 Create your home by accessing your inventory! All blocks inside it are saved forever.💾

💸 Earn coins every minute you play!
🤑 Coins can be used in our fully-stocked shop!
💾 Your items save, no matter what server!
🗺️ Explore a never-ending world with your friends
🌲 Mine different materials such as dirt, stone, wood, sand and many more!
🐱 Many animals spawns. Do you want a pig pet?

💎Join the group for 15000 coins (you need to rejoin)💎
https://www.roblox.com/communities/502742426/OFFICIAL-WhyMe-Studio



⚠️ DISCLAIMER: This game is an original creation developed from scratch for the Roblox platform, featuring no copyrighted material.
